module_summary: 4-bit carry-lookahead adder block: per-bit propagate/generate feed a CLA child computing carries for four 1-bit adder instances, plus group Pm/Gm outputs.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: First 4-bit operand feeding adders and propagate/generate logic.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Second 4-bit operand feeding adders and propagate/generate logic.

anchors.name: F
anchors.why: 4-bit sum from the four bit adders.

anchors.name: c0
anchors.why: Carry-in to first adder and CLA.

anchors.name: Gm
anchors.why: Group generate output for higher-level lookahead.

anchors.name: Pm
anchors.why: Group propagate output for higher-level lookahead.

anchors.name: p1
anchors.why: Bit propagate x^y into CLA; p2-p4 replicate.

anchors.name: g1
anchors.why: Bit generate x&y into CLA; g2-g4 replicate.

anchors.name: c1
anchors.why: Lookahead carry from CLA into adder2; c2,c3 replicate.

groups.name: bit_adders
groups.description: Four 1-bit adders summing x, y with lookahead carries.

groups.name: carry_lookahead
groups.description: Propagate/generate terms and CLA child producing carries c1-c4.
